젤튼튼 키즈 알티지 오메가3 츄어블Vitamin A · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Zinc · Omega-3

Made by 코스맥스엔비티(주) · Once a day · 3 capsules

This product combines 0.42mg of Vitamin A, 10μg of Vitamin D, 3.34mg of Vitamin E, 4.3mg of Zinc, 500mg of Omega-3 as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (3 capsules): 0.42mg Vitamin A, 10μg Vitamin D, 3.34mg Vitamin E, 4.3mg Zinc, 500mg Omega-3
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 코스맥스엔비티(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Omega-3
    • May help with improving blood triglyceride levels and improving blood circulation

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day3 capsules per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Vitamin A labelled (0.42mg / 2100mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (10μg / 2100mg), 80~180%
Vitamin E labelled (3.34mg / 2100mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (4.3mg / 2100mg), 80~150%
Omega-3 labelled (500mg / 2100mg), 80~120%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 주황색의 점도가 있는 내용물을 함유한 주황색의 타원형 츄어블 연질캡슐
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 실온보관 / 1)직사광선이나 고온다습한 곳을 피하여 청결하고 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오.2)영･유아 및 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin A · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Zinc · Omega-3 together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

This product combines 1.4mg of Vitamin A, 25μg of Vitamin D, 11mg of Vitamin E, 8.5mg of Zinc, 900mg of Omega-3 as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (2 capsules): 1.4mg Vitamin A, 25μg Vitamin D, 11mg Vitamin E, 8.5mg Zinc, 900mg Omega-3
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)알피바이오

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Omega-3
    • May help with improving blood triglyceride levels and improving blood circulation
    • May help with memory improvement
    • May help with improving dry eyes for eye health
